values.value: [SETUP] --------------------------------------------------------- - Configure the props you'd like to use with the right handed setup using the green nodes - Configure the props you'd like to use with the left handed setup using the yellow nodes - Set the resolution of the monitor you are tracking movement on using the green parameter operation nodes beside this message. - If you are using a Leap Motion tracking position other than desktop, you can disable this graph's Leap Motion integration by disconnecting the green Leap Motion nodes to the far right of this node block. Specify a websocket/hotkey command in the cyan nodes above and below to trigger the graph and start drawing! You could also set up a hotkey using the same connections if preferred.

[LEAP MOTION TRACKING NOTE] This graph was built around a desktop mounted Leap Motion device. If you are using another orientation such as a chest or neck mounted device, it will be hard for it to lose tracking as your arms will almost always be in view. This will affect the overall effect and may make it difficult to detect/lose tracking and impact the ability for the graph to perform as intended. Use the Ultraleap software running your Leap Motion to visualize how it tracks your arms/hands.
